kebab_example: aliyun agentloop update-context-store --agent-space my-agent-space --context-store-name my-context-store --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateContextStore

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace, which must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the context store to be updated, which must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 待更新的上下文库名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the policy change. A new policy version is created when policy fields in the configuration are modified
parameters.help_zh: 策略变更说明；config 中策略字段有变化时写入新策略版本
parameters.name: change_note

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to write item events for dropped recall candidates. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 召回被丢弃的候选是否也写 item 事件，默认 false
fields.name: dropped_candidates

fields.help_en: The recording mode for recall queries. Valid values: raw (plaintext) and hash (HMAC only). Default value: raw
fields.help_zh: 召回 query 记录方式：raw（明文）/ hash（仅 HMAC），默认 raw
fields.name: query_mode

fields.help_en: The number of days to retain audit logs. Valid values: 1 to 180. Default value: 30
fields.help_zh: 审计日志保留天数，取值 1-180，默认 30
fields.name: retention_days

fields.help_en: The audit configuration
fields.help_zh: 审计配置
fields.name: audit

fields.help_en: The list of memory categories
fields.help_zh: 记忆分类列表
fields.name: categories

fields.example: 只抽取用户的产品偏好
fields.help_en: The custom extraction instructions. This parameter is required when preset is set to custom. Length: 1 to 8000 characters
fields.help_zh: 自定义抽取指令，preset=custom 时必填，长度 1-8000
fields.name: custom_instructions

fields.help_en: The list of exclusion rules. Content that matches these rules is not extracted
fields.help_zh: 排除规则列表，命中的内容不抽取
fields.name: exclude_rules

fields.help_en: The name of the extraction model. Currently, only qwen3.8-flash is supported, which uses internal platform credentials
fields.help_zh: 抽取模型名称，当前仅支持 qwen3.8-flash，使用平台内部凭据
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The extraction model configuration
fields.help_zh: 抽取模型配置
fields.name: model

fields.help_en: The preset policy. Valid values: fact, toc-profile, tob-digital-twin, and custom. Default value: fact
fields.help_zh: 预设策略：fact / toc-profile / tob-digital-twin / custom，默认 fact
fields.name: preset

fields.help_en: The extraction policy for the memory type
fields.help_zh: 抽取策略（memory 类型）
fields.name: extraction_policy

fields.help_en: The metadata field mapping. The key is the business field, and the value is the storage field
fields.help_zh: 元数据字段映射，key 为业务字段，value 为存储字段
fields.name: metadata_field

fields.help_en: The list of scope fields where at least one must be non-empty. Valid element values: userId, agentId, appId, and runId
fields.help_zh: 至少需要其中一个 scope 字段非空；元素取值 userId / agentId / appId / runId
fields.name: required_any_of

fields.help_en: The scope constraint policy
fields.help_zh: scope 约束策略
fields.name: scope_policy

fields.help_en: The AgentSpace where the trace data source is located. Cross-AgentSpace is not supported in the current phase. If provided, it must be equal to the path AgentSpace. Otherwise, a 400 parameter error is returned. The AgentSpace cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: trace 数据源所在的 AgentSpace；本期不支持跨 AgentSpace，若传入必须等于 path AgentSpace，否则返回 400 参数错误。AgentSpace 创建后不可变更
fields.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: The description of the field. This parameter is required when usage is set to extraction-input
fields.help_zh: 字段说明，usage=extraction-input 时必填
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the field is a sensitive field
fields.help_zh: 是否敏感字段
fields.name: sensitive

fields.help_en: The name of the source field
fields.help_zh: 源字段名
fields.name: source_field

fields.help_en: The target write path, such as metadata.customerTier
fields.help_zh: 写入目标路径，例如 metadata.customerTier
fields.name: target

fields.help_en: The usage of the field. Valid values: extraction-input (participates in extraction) and ignore (ignored)
fields.help_zh: 用途：extraction-input（参与抽取）/ ignore（忽略）
fields.name: usage

fields.help_en: The list of custom field declarations. If provided, it fully overwrites the existing declarations
fields.help_zh: 自定义字段声明列表，传入即整体覆盖
fields.name: custom_fields

fields.help_en: The subset of the Pipeline where clause, which is pushed down to SQL
fields.help_zh: Pipeline where 子集，下推到 SQL
fields.name: where

fields.help_en: The row filter conditions
fields.help_zh: 行过滤条件
fields.name: filter

fields.help_en: The polling interval in seconds. Valid values: 60 to 3600
fields.help_zh: 轮询间隔秒数，取值 60-3600
fields.name: poll_interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The updatable items for the Dataset data source. The datasetName cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: Dataset 数据源可更新项（datasetName 创建后不可变更）
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: The start time for data backfill, in ISO 8601 UTC format
fields.help_zh: 数据回灌起始时间，ISO 8601 UTC 格式
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The list of agent names. An explicitly empty list returns a 400 error
fields.help_zh: Agent 名列表；显式空列表返回 400
fields.name: agent_names

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude degraded trajectories. Default value: false (degraded trajectories are included)
fields.help_zh: 是否排除 degraded 轨迹，默认 false（包含降级轨迹）
fields.name: exclude_degraded

fields.help_en: The minimum number of steps, which must be greater than or equal to 0
fields.help_zh: 最小步数，大于等于 0
fields.name: min_step_count

fields.help_en: The native SLS query statement. This statement is combined with the preceding conditions by using the AND operator
fields.help_zh: 原生 SLS 检索语句，与以上条件 AND
fields.name: query

fields.help_en: The list of service names. A single trailing asterisk (*) is supported. Specifying an explicitly empty list returns a 400 error
fields.help_zh: 服务名列表，支持单尾缀 *；显式空列表返回 400
fields.name: service_names

fields.help_en: The trajectory filter conditions. Conditions are combined with AND, while items within a list are combined with OR
fields.help_zh: 轨迹过滤条件；各条件之间 AND，列表内 OR
fields.name: filter

fields.help_en: The name of the trajectory Logstore. Default value: agent-trajectory. This parameter cannot be modified after creation
fields.help_zh: 轨迹 Logstore 名称，默认 agent-trajectory；创建后不可变更
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The polling interval in seconds. Valid values: 60 to 3600
fields.help_zh: 轮询间隔秒数，取值 60-3600
fields.name: poll_interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for the agentId field. Default value: $.agent_name
fields.help_zh: agentId 的 JSONPath，默认 $.agent_name
fields.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for the appId field. Default value: $.service_names[0]
fields.help_zh: appId 的 JSONPath，默认 $.service_names[0]
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for the runId field. Default value: $.trajectory_id
fields.help_zh: runId 的 JSONPath，默认 $.trajectory_id
fields.name: run_id

fields.help_en: The JSONPath expression for the userId field. By default, this field is not mapped
fields.help_zh: userId 的 JSONPath；缺省不映射
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The scope field mapping. The value must be a JSONPath expression. Only the $.a.b and $.a[0] formats are supported
fields.help_zh: scope 字段映射，值为 JSONPath（仅支持 $.a.b 与 $.a[0] 形式）
fields.name: scope_mapping

fields.help_en: The updatable items for the trajectory data source. The source.type cannot be changed after creation
fields.help_zh: 轨迹数据源可更新项（source.type 创建后不可变更）
fields.name: trajectory

fields.help_en: The datasource config, which serves only as the root identity for the data source
fields.help_zh: 数据源配置，仅作为数据源根标识
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The allowed storage actions. By default, all actions are allowed: ADD, UPDATE, MERGE, and DELETE
fields.help_zh: 允许的存储动作，默认全部：ADD / UPDATE / MERGE / DELETE
fields.name: allowed_actions

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to deduplicate events in event mode. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: event 模式是否去重，默认 true
fields.name: dedupe

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable human edit protection. Default value: true. When this feature is enabled, automatic extraction does not overwrite manually modified memories
fields.help_zh: 人工编辑保护，默认 true；开启后自动抽取不覆盖人工修改过的记忆
fields.name: human_edit_protection

fields.help_en: The merge key for upsert operations. Valid values: factKey, semantic, and both. Default value: semantic
fields.help_zh: upsert 合并键：factKey / semantic / both，默认 semantic
fields.name: merge_key

fields.help_en: The storage mode. Valid values: event (append events) and upsert (merge and update). Default value: upsert
fields.help_zh: 存储模式：event（事件追加）/ upsert（合并更新），默认 upsert
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The similarity threshold for semantic merging. Valid values: 0 to 1. Default value: 0.4
fields.help_zh: 语义合并相似度阈值，取值 0-1，默认 0.4
fields.name: similarity_threshold

fields.help_en: The number of days before the memory expires. A value of 0 indicates that the memory never expires
fields.help_zh: 记忆过期天数，0 表示不过期
fields.name: ttl_days

fields.help_en: The storage policy for the memory type
fields.help_zh: 存储策略（memory 类型）
fields.name: storage_policy

parameters.help_en: The context library configuration. If provided, it fully overwrites the existing configuration. If omitted, the original configuration is retained
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库配置，传入即整体覆盖；不传则保持原配置
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The context library type. This field is typically immutable after creation and is provided only for exception correction
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库类型；创建后通常不可变更，提供该字段仅用于异常修正
parameters.name: context_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the context library, which helps business users understand its purpose
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库描述，便于业务方理解用途
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The running status. For the memory type, valid values are Active (running) and Paused (data source consumption and extraction paused). For the experience type, it indicates the mining status of the experience library. The specific valid values and combination constraints are defined by the server
parameters.help_zh: 运行状态：memory 类型为 Active（运行）/ Paused（暂停数据源消费与抽取）；experience 类型为经验库挖掘状态，具体合法值及组合约束由服务端定义
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. It is a unique string generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the update operation
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token，客户端生成的唯一字符串，保证更新操作幂等
parameters.name: client_token

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求

strategyVersion.description_en: The effective strategy version number after the update for the memory type. If the strategy remains unchanged, the version number is the same as before the update
strategyVersion.description_zh: 更新后生效的策略版本号（memory 类型）；策略未变化时与更新前相同
strategyVersion.title_en: 更新后生效的策略版本号（memory 类型）；策略未变化时与更新前相同
strategyVersion.title_zh: 更新后生效的策略版本号（memory 类型）；策略未变化时与更新前相同
